subject: Request: Exec approval for >20% discount - Neurolytics Hosted API
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec approval for >20% discount - Neurolytics Hosted API

Hi team,

Quick escalation for Neurolytics (strategic healthcare analytics startup). They want us to sign a 12‑month hosted API contract and are asking for a 30% usage discount across the term. Key facts:

- Estimated usage: ~120M tokens/mo (inbound+generation) — list monthly spend ~$36k.
- 12‑month term (requested).
- Proposed commercial: 30% off hosted API unit rates for duration.
- Rationale: reference customer potential (clinical research partner), very aggressive procurement timeline (needs paper signed in 2 weeks), competitor (CloudAI) already offered 25% with a trial period.

Attachments: MutualActionPlan_Neurolytics_v3.pdf, Pricing_Summary_Neurolytics.xlsx (pricing + term impact).

Ask: I need exec approval for a discount greater than 20% (they pushed to 30%). Recommend we approve up to 22% with a required minimum monthly commitment and SLA terms — but I want a final signoff from Vivek or Rishi before I present to the customer.

Why approve: strategic reference, strong upsell potential (expected 2–3x in 12–18 months if we lock integration), short close window — but margins are sensitive.

Please confirm: 1) acceptable top-line discount cap, 2) required commercial guardrails (min monthly commitment, term, no stacking with other promos), 3) legal/finance items to require before signature.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0134
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Exec approval for >20% discount - Neurolytics Hosted API

Vivek/Rishi — forwarding Hannah's request and attaching a margin calc. Bottom line: 30% would put unit economics below acceptable threshold for hosted API at projected volumes unless we secure a higher committed spend or trading terms (e.g., prepay or minimum monthly).

Recommendation: Approve up to 22% with the following guardrails:
- 12‑month term with a $250k committed ARR minimum (or prepay equivalent).
- No stacking with channel/partner credits; discount applies only to hosted API usage line item.
- Standard SLA terms (30ms p50 target; credits only after legal signoff).

Attachments: Margin_Calc_NL_v2.xlsx (shows margin at 20/22/25/30%).

If you approve, I'll prepare the negotiated commercial and update the Mutual Action Plan.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Exec approval for >20% discount - Neurolytics Hosted API

I reviewed the margin calc and strategic ask. Approve a maximum 22% discount under the following conditions:

1) 12‑month firm commitment with a minimum total contracted spend of $270,000 (equivalent to ~22.5k/mo net after discount).
2) Minimum monthly billing floor (if actual usage falls below floor, customer pays the difference).
3) No additional promotional stacking; any future price concessions must return to Deal Desk for reapproval.
4) Legal to add a 60‑day performance review clause and to confirm SLA/Credit language.

Dylan — proceed to finalize the commercial and get Legal (Neha) to draft the amended terms. Hannah — present 22% as the final executive concession, emphasize the minimum spend and the performance review clause.

Vivek Kulkarni | CEO | Redwood Inference

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for the productive call yesterday. I have executive confirmation and can offer the following:

- 22% off hosted API unit rates for a 12‑month committed term.
- Minimum contracted spend: $270,000 over 12 months (monthly floor applies).
- Standard SLA applies; we will include a 60‑day performance review clause.
- No stacking with other discounts or promotional credits.

I've attached the updated Mutual Action Plan and Pricing Summary for your review. If this is acceptable, we'll send a DocuSign packet (contract + SOW + SLA) — link below.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/tx/AAABBB-NEUROLYTICS-2026

Best,
Hannah
